components.name: Emerald Wordmark
components.description: The all-emerald TrackerPal identity, pairing an authoritative deep tone with a bright highlight.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: flex; align-items: baseline; font: 900 31px/.95 Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-wordmark span { color: var(--brand-deep, #065f46); } .ds-wordmark em { color: var(--brand-bright, #10b981); font-style: normal; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive emerald action for adding, saving, or retrying.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--green, #08734b); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--green, #08734b); color: #fff; font: 750 16px Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(16,35,59,.05); transition: transform 140ms ease-out, box-shadow 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #065e3d; border-color: #065e3d; box-shadow: 0 7px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #087a55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet command for routine operational actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #c8d9d0; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #10271f); font: 750 16px Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(16,35,59,.05); transition: transform 140ms ease-out, box-shadow 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: #93b7a4; box-shadow: 0 7px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #087a55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The full-width entry point for narrowing orders.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" aria-label="Search orders" placeholder="Search orders, stores, or tracking numbers">
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d6e3dc); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--soft, #f3f8f5); color: var(--ink, #10271f); font: 400 16px Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #586d64); opacity: 1; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #087a55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Filter
components.description: A pressed filter with emerald selection feedback.
components.css: .ds-filter-active { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid #84c8a6; border-radius: 999px; background: #ddf3e7; color: #075f3e; font: 700 16px Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-filter-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #087a55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Metric
components.description: A scan-first count with a semantic baseline.
components.css: .ds-stat { position: relative; min-height: 94px; padding: 18px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #10271f); box-shadow: 0 7px 24px rgba(16,39,31,.07); font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-stat::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; height: 4px; background: #10b981; } .ds-stat strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat span { color: var(--muted, #586d64); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 720; letter-spacing: .045em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Exception Signal
components.description: An explicit semantic pill for an order requiring attention.
components.css: .ds-signal-exception { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 26px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fce8e6; color: var(--red, #b42318); font: 700 12px Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Workspace
components.description: The white operational plane that owns filtering and order data.
components.css: .ds-workspace { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #10271f); box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(16,39,31,.12); font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-workspace-toolbar { padding: 16px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d6e3dc); font-weight: 750; } .ds-workspace-row { padding: 15px 18px; } .ds-workspace-row:hover { background: #f5faf7; } .ds-workspace:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #087a55); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
TrackerPal is a modern, focused operations surface: calm enough for repeated daily use, but decisive when a package needs attention. A light green ambient scene and forest-ink information frame keep the console crisp; operational emerald carries actions, focus, links, selection, due-today cues, and healthy state.

The visual identity is entirely emerald. The wordmark and brand icon use deep and bright emerald together, while metrics, filters, table signals, and form controls form a compact scan-and-act rhythm. Red remains strictly semantic for overdue, exception, destructive, and error states; all routine and positive signals stay green or neutral.
keyCharacteristics: Emerald-led hierarchy across branding, actions, focus, links, and successful state.
Forest-tinted text, white work surfaces, and pale green ambient backgrounds.
Deep and bright emerald form the TrackerPal wordmark and icon signature.
Compact status density with generous 44px interaction targets.
Responsive data presentation that becomes labeled rows on small screens.

rules.name: The Emerald Continuity Rule
rules.body: Brand marks, primary actions, focus rings, links, selected states, and success feedback stay within the emerald family.

rules.name: The Status Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Bright and muted emerald distinguish routine status; red is reserved for exceptions and errors. Color always supplements explicit text.

rules.name: The One Brand Family Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a separate accent family into the wordmark, icon, or routine interface controls.

rules.name: The Scan Before Flourish Rule
rules.body: Prefer weight, alignment, and tabular figures over ornamental typography.

rules.name: The Data Reflows Rule
rules.body: Never preserve a desktop-width table by forcing horizontal page scrolling on mobile; convert columns into explicit labeled rows.

rules.name: The Neutral Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows use translucent deep ink or black; emerald communicates state through fills, strokes, and type rather than cast light.

rules.name: The Radius Follows Scale Rule
rules.body: Larger containers receive larger corners; do not give every element the same generic radius.

dos: Do keep branding and routine interaction entirely within the deep-to-bright emerald family.
Do use deep and bright emerald together for the TrackerPal wordmark and icon signature.
Do make status the first scanning cue through explicit labels, ordering, and restrained semantic color.
Do keep primary main-app controls at least 44px tall and retain the visible emerald focus treatment.
Do preserve labeled-row mobile behavior, modal focus management, live regions, and HTTP(S)-only tracking links.
donts: Don't reintroduce a non-emerald split-color treatment into TrackerPal branding.
Don't use red as decoration or as a routine accent; it communicates overdue, exception, destructive, and error states only.
Don't add glassy, colored, or theatrical shadows; elevation stays neutral and operational.
Don't compress dense controls below their source-defined touch targets or hide state behind color alone.
Don't allow untrusted tracking protocols or remove the dialog, focus, reduced-motion, and live-feedback safeguards.
